title: Failure Ownership Separation
problem: Proof failures can be treated as product defects even when the real owner is control-plane, deployment, upstream dependency, verifier, or external infrastructure.
root_cause: MONSTER already had a frozen low-level failure ownership engine, but API2 proof steps did not have one permanent routing layer that translated ownership into product-vs-nonproduct repair domains and enforced mutation scope before patch/retry.
patch: Reuse the frozen MONSTER Failure Ownership Engine V1. Add an API2 failure-domain router that emits exactly one repair domain, product mutation permission, scoped legal action, and deterministic decision fingerprint. Install its self-test and permanent test in DevSystem targeted CI.
